title: 第二十章自力更生第十九章整顿山寨求推荐
content_zh:
第二十章自力更生
在陈林的安排下，飞燕寨所有的人都开始忙碌起来，很快天色渐渐的暗淡下来，转眼间晚上吃饭的时间就到了，因为这里的人数太多，飞燕寨每天也只能提供两顿饭。
山寨下那些难民还有一些新来的难民，都在等待着飞燕寨发放晚饭的时候，看着山下又多了很多的难民，顾飞燕顿时觉飞燕寨要这样下去，一定会像陈林说的那样的下场。
飞燕寨是顾飞燕辛辛苦苦的建立起来的，很不愿意看见飞燕寨覆灭，飞燕寨的情况她也是知道的，但是看着周围的难民，她又不忍心不管，所以自己一直不愿意相信也不知道怎么面对。
飞燕寨外的难民在天黑后，都开始向着飞燕寨聚集起来，在这里所有都能领到一份吃的，只要有了这份吃的，大家也就能活下去。但是今天发放晚饭的人却迟迟的没有来，这让在飞燕寨门口的人开始焦急起来。
就在大家不断议论开始要着急的时候，在山寨里发放吃的人，终于抬着热腾腾的饭从寨子里出来，这些人顿时开始向着山寨门口处涌了过来！
就在大家准备领取饭菜的时候，山寨门口却被一群人堵住了，这些人没人手里都拿着一柄武器，虽然这些人的穿着股不相同，而且手里的武器更是各种各样，但是这群人却整整齐齐的站在寨门口，一言不发很有气势，一时间又有的人都没有赶上前去的。
陈林这个时候，适时的出现来到了寨门前，看着这些焦急却又有点胆怯的难民，陈林挣了下面容开口说道“马上就要发放晚饭了，不过在发放之前我有几句话要说。”
所有的人对陈林的出现，都很意外没人知道他是谁，也不知道他将要说什么，不过为了能吃上一口饭，大家都难着性子听他把话说完。
陈林看了看还算平静的这些人说道“飞燕寨已经免费施舍饭菜很长时间了！相信很多人已经吃了很长时间了！”
说完陈林顿了顿看着周围，有很多人都点了点头流露出感激的表情，更多的人正在思索着，陈林的话是要表达什么意思。
接着陈林又说道“但是由于人数越来越多，飞燕寨决定明天开始不再施舍饭菜……”
听陈林这么一说，所有的人都蒙住了，有的人甚至开始愤怒的指责，有的人开始着急自己以后的日子怎么过，有的更是大骂起来，更甚者说着说着强盗理论蛊惑人心，要聚众闹事。
这个时候，陈林大声说道“都给我安静！”陈林利用上了灵魂气势，顿时像是一个炸雷一样，在大家的耳边响起。接着陈林背后的整齐的五百多人，整齐的喊了一句“安静！”
这次所有的人都安静下来，五百人一起大喊的气势，直接震慑到所有的人。这个时候陈林才接着说道“大家都不用担心，今天晚上还是会继续发放的，而且明天开始，只要愿意为飞燕寨劳动的人，也会得到一份吃的。”
这个时候听陈林说今晚还有吃的，大半的人都没有在理论，毕竟这些人的生活本就是饥一顿饱一顿。接着听陈林又说只要劳动就会有一份吃的，剩下的人也都很理解的没有在说什么。
但是还是有那么一部分人不乐意，他们纷纷对飞燕寨，突然不再发放饭菜有很大的意见。
“凭什么啊，我们为什么要为你们劳动啊！难道要我们给你做奴隶吗！你们这也太欺负人了！”有一个人带头说道。
有人带头自然有呼应的，于是很多人就开始说道“对啊”
“就是就是！”

“你们这些吸血鬼！”
经过这些人一说，顿时周围的人也觉得飞燕寨，做的很不应该一样。陈林看了一眼大头说话的人，不断在人群里面呼应的人冷冷的笑着，回头说道“这些人都给我记好了，以后再来都给我乱棍打出去。”
然后对着周围的人说道“飞燕寨无偿的给予，并没有向你们要什么。而且劳不劳动完全自愿，有谁有意见，大可以自己寻找出路，飞燕寨是不会要这样忘恩负义的家伙的。”
说完陈林看了看那几个挑事的人，很不屑的笑了笑心道“这些人都是些喂不饱的额白眼狼，给他们好处，他们就会索要更多……”
这个时候挑事的几人，顿时被周围的人孤立了，看着周围人异样的眼光，有个人恼羞成怒的说道“听说飞燕寨寨主是个大善人，现在看来就是一个大骗子！”
陈林一听顿时怒了“你说什么，你他吗的这些天吃的都是谁给你的！我们养了你这么多天，而且还给了你们一个糊口的机会，你不记恩情也就罢了，现在竟然还在污蔑我们寨主，你这种人就是喂不饱的白眼狼，现在你就是来我们山寨，我们也不会要。给我滚！”

Chapter 20 Self-reliance
Under Chen Lin's arrangement, everyone in Feiyan Village began to get busy. Soon the sky gradually dimmed. In the blink of an eye, it was time for dinner. Because there were too many people here, Feiyan Village could only provide two meals a day.
The refugees and some newly arrived refugees at the foot of the mountain village were all waiting for Feiyan Village to hand out dinner. Seeing that there were many more refugees at the foot of the mountain, Gu Feiyan suddenly felt that if Feiyan Village continued like this, it would definitely end like what Chen Lin said.
Gu Feiyan had worked hard to build Feiyan Village, and she didn't want to see Feiyan Village destroyed. She also knew the situation in Feiyan Village, but looking at the refugees around her, she couldn't bear to ignore it, so she never wanted to believe it and didn't know how to face it.
The refugees outside Feiyan Village began to gather towards Feiyan Village after dark. Everyone here can get a piece of food. As long as they have this food, everyone can survive. However, the person who handed out dinner today did not come for a long time, which made the people at the gate of Feiyan Village start to become anxious.
Just when everyone was talking about getting anxious, the people who were handing out food to the village finally came out of the village carrying hot meals. These people immediately started to pour towards the entrance of the village!
Just when everyone was about to receive the food, the entrance to the village was blocked by a group of people. None of these people held a weapon in their hands. Although these people were dressed in different clothes and had various weapons in their hands, this group of people stood neatly at the entrance of the village, silent and imposing. For a while, no one could catch up.
At this time, Chen Lin appeared in front of the village gate at the right time. Looking at these anxious but timid refugees, Chen Lin grimaced and said, "Dinner will be distributed soon, but I have a few words to say before distributing it."
Everyone was surprised by Chen Lin's appearance. No one knew who he was or what he was going to say. However, in order to have a bite of food, everyone reluctantly listened to what he had to say.
Chen Lin looked at the calm people and said, "Feiyan Village has been giving out free meals for a long time! I believe many people have been eating for a long time!"
After speaking, Chen Lin paused and looked around. Many people nodded with expressions of gratitude, and more people were thinking about what Chen Lin meant by his words.
Then Chen Lin said, "But due to the increasing number of people, Feiyanzhai has decided not to give away food from tomorrow..."
After hearing what Chen Lin said, everyone was dumbfounded. Some people even started to accuse angrily, some people started to worry about how they would live their lives in the future, and some even started to curse. What's more, they talked about gangster theories to confuse people's hearts and wanted to gather people to cause trouble.
At this time, Chen Lin said loudly, "Quiet, everyone!" Chen Lin took advantage of the soul momentum, and it suddenly sounded like a thunder in everyone's ears. Then the more than 500 people behind Chen Lin uniformly shouted "Quiet!"
This time everyone fell silent, and the momentum of five hundred people shouting at the same time directly shocked everyone. At this time, Chen Lincai continued, "Don't worry, everyone, the distribution will continue tonight, and starting tomorrow, anyone who is willing to work for Feiyan Village will also get a piece of food."
At this time, when Chen Lin said that there was still food tonight, most of the people didn't think anything of it. After all, these people's life is about eating when they are hungry and when they are full. Then I heard Chen Lin say that as long as he worked, he would have something to eat, and the rest of the people understood very well and didn't say anything.
However, there are still some people who are not happy. They all have great opinions on Feiyan Village suddenly no longer distributing meals.
"Why, why do we have to work for you! Do you want us to be your slaves? You are too bullyingGot it! "One person took the lead and said.
Someone took the lead and responded naturally, so many people began to say, "Yes."
“That’s right! "
“You vampires! "
After these people talked about it, people around them suddenly felt that Feiyanzhai should not be doing the same thing. Chen Lin glanced at the person who was talking, and the person who kept echoing in the crowd smiled coldly, and turned around and said, "I have memorized these people, and I will beat them out with sticks whenever they come again." "
Then he said to the people around him, "Feiyan Village gives freely and does not ask for anything from you. Moreover, whether or not to work is completely voluntary. Anyone who has an opinion can find a way out by himself. Feiyan Village will not want such an ungrateful guy. "
After saying that, Chen Lin looked at the people who were making trouble, smiled disdainfully and said, "These people are all insatiable white-eyed wolves. If you give them benefits, they will ask for more..."
At this time, the few people who stirred up trouble were suddenly isolated by the people around them. Seeing the strange looks from the people around them, one person said angrily, "I heard that the leader of Feiyan Village is a kind person, but now it seems that he is a big liar!" "
When Chen Lin heard this, he immediately became angry, "What are you talking about? Who gave you all your food these days!" We have raised you for so many days and given you a chance to make a living. It’s okay if you don’t remember the kindness. Now you are still slandering our village master. People like you are just white-eyed wolves who can’t get enough to eat. Even if you come to our village now, we won’t want you. Get out of here! "
